signIn.title: Which GREEN-API instance do you want to sign in with?
signIn.hint: Instance credentials are in your GREEN-API console — tap “?” to see where
signIn.disclaimer: Credentials stay in this browser and go straight to GREEN-API

problems.notAuthorized: The instance is not authorized in MAX — scan the QR code in the console.
problems.webhookUrlSet: webhookUrl is set in the instance settings — clear it, otherwise HTTP API gets no notifications.
problems.notificationsDisabled: Enable incoming notifications and API sending notifications in the instance settings.

help.title: Where to find credentials
help.step1: Open the <link>GREEN-API console</link> and pick your MAX instance.
help.step2: Copy apiUrl, idInstance and apiTokenInstance from the instance page.
help.step3: In the instance settings keep webhookUrl empty and enable notifications.

chats.title: Chats
chats.empty: Enter a recipient's phone number to start a conversation

chat.placeholder: Pick a chat or start a new one
chat.noMessages: No messages yet — say hi first

validation.apiUrl: Enter the apiUrl from your console

errors.network: Can't reach the GREEN-API server — check apiUrl and your connection
errors.timeout: The server did not respond — please try again

status.404: Instance not found — check apiUrl and idInstance
status.429: Too many requests, try again later
status.466: Your plan's request limit is exhausted
